notes.title: v1.1.0 - Leaderboards, New Skin, macOS & More
notes.content:
[h3]Leaderboards[/h3]
Leaderbords for any% time and highest tier have been added to the game! They're visible after completing the game for the first time.
Ingame time is tracked only on save files created on v1.0.4 or after (May 15th, 6 days ago as of this post).
And, if you're really interested in speedrunning: https://www.speedrun.com/Snakecremental
[h3]New Skin[/h3]
Wade, who was the first to find the Egg after release has created a skin to be added into the game. If you've found a couple of other secrets, this one shouldn't be hard to find.
The skin was made by Wade & the Meme Team.
[h3]Android Version[/h3]
Snakecremental is now on [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.WalkingCatStudios.Snakecremental]Google Play[/url]! Demo included.
[h3]MacOS Version[/h3]
An experimental macOS version has been released. If you're on macOS, report any bugs or successes on the Discord server. MacOS will not be shown as supported on the store page for now.
[h3]Everything else[/h3]
Discord server - https://discord.gg/z3QthbQCnv
Full patch notes:
[list]
[*]Added a new skin
[*]Added 2 achievements
[*]Added leaderboards (visible after completing the game for the first time)
[*]Added a speedrun timer option (visible after completing the game for the first time)
[*]Added a new color to the Colorless (visual only)
[*]Added a (gameplay) effect to one very specific upgrade
[*]Added/Changed symbols for notating very big numbers
[*]Added snake controls with the right analog stick
[*]Changed x10 combo achievement to x20
[*]Changed the pink-collection particle color to include the collected colors color (color)
[*]Changed a few achievement descriptions and sprites
[*]Changed the executable icon (slightly)
[*]Fixed some issues on different aspect ratios
[*]Reordered languages
[/list]

notes.title: Release + Egg hunt
notes.content:
Snakecremental has been released!
I've hidden an Egg somewhere in the game, and if you're the first to find it, I'll add a SKIN OF YOUR CHOICE to the game.
Good luck and have fun.

Wade has found the Egg, and the new skin is on its way.
